description: List supported external identifier systems, a non-exhaustive taxonomic-status guide grouped as accepted, unaccepted, uncertain, or technical, environment-flag semantics, observed worms_get_distributions filter values, live taxonomic ranks, or live trait definitions. Resume nextResultOffset as resultOffset with the same topic. Identifier codes, statuses, environment flags, and distribution terms are available offline. A record status can be the specific reason itself, such as junior subjective synonym, rather than unaccepted. IUCN identifiers are not threat categories; null flags mean not recorded. Trait definitions retain complete-tree preorder indices across pages; parents may be on earlier pages.
